scope: Collect × Codex, full Admin operations workflows and the unattended payment-to-receipt target

items.task: Freeze one reviewed release candidate.
items.closure: Preserve concurrent work, agree the trusted origin and accountable owners, integrate compatible changes, pin dependencies/toolchains and retain source/artifact hashes from a clean checkout.

items.task: Restore the approved operator session.
items.closure: Complete normal local sign-in without putting OTPs/tokens in chat; verify current approval, role, permissions, Keychain handling, expiry and revocation. Retained probe is SHADOW_SESSION_REQUIRED.

items.task: Verify the deployed MCP installation and tool inventory.
items.closure: Pin the local bridge/runtime and supported installation, reload/discover the five allowed reads, exclude unrestricted controls and duplicate connections, and verify safe error/redaction behavior. A plugin is optional packaging; HTTP/OAuth is required only if remote HTTP is selected.

items.task: Deploy compatible backend contracts and navigation.
items.closure: Refresh the hosted baseline, rehearse clean and populated upgrades plus rollback/roll-forward, deploy reviewed prerequisites/navigation/shadow contracts, and read back exact bodies, RLS, grants, Auth, flags and cron. Verify retirement of unsupported legacy bank execution.

items.task: Build and host the latest Admin bundle.
items.closure: Compile current source including shadow history; verify production configuration, configured navigation/deep links, authenticated/public separation, headers and cache/upgrade/logout behavior. The retained earlier build excludes history.

items.task: Validate every enabled MCP read against the hosted backend.
items.closure: Exercise health, pending work, exact receipt status and failures with authorized nonempty test evidence; prove denied/cross-scope/replaced-session/stale/malformed/deadline behavior and no unintended writes. An empty failure page does not validate exact receipt lookup.

items.task: Run and reconcile a real manual shadow lifecycle.
items.closure: Prove begin/sample/finish/history with the approved identity, durable records, BUSY, expiry, fence loss, session replacement, unknown-response lookup and server-derived counters. Confirm only telemetry changes; completion must not imply current health or message delivery.

items.task: Rerun complete acceptance on the frozen candidate.
items.closure: Run full Flutter/native/Edge/database/browser suites, representative populated upgrades and negative/concurrency cases; retain exact logs, exclusions and source bindings. Scoped test counts cannot close whole-system gates.

items.task: Complete the operations Overview.
items.closure: Add posted-today payment/value metrics, receipt age, definite failures and unknown outcomes; separate ingestion, telephony, internet and supervisor freshness; link real policy-based alerts to filtered worklists and isolate partial failures.

items.task: Separate transaction lifecycle states.
items.closure: Expose provider reference, payer/intended member/group and independent verification, allocation, ledger and notification states; preserve pagination/filter/scope correctness. The current transaction table has one aggregate Status column.

items.task: Complete transaction investigation.
items.closure: Join ingestion→parse→verification→allocation→posting→receipt→attempt→delivery evidence; distinguish posting-time receipt snapshots from current balances, show permitted/blocked actions and version conflicts, and preserve audited privileged raw-evidence reveal.

items.task: Complete a cross-service exception inbox.
items.closure: Cover member/group ambiguity, unsupported parsing, verification differences, missing contacts, gateway outages and uncertain sends with category, age, owner, severity, evidence, exact previews and governed approval. Reuse existing financial reconciliation.

items.task: Complete notification investigation and permitted actions.
items.closure: Display immutable payload/version/snapshot context, masked destination, segment estimate, attempts/journal/per-part callbacks and original/resend/correction links. Add only backend-authorized cancellation/retry/resend; unknown outcomes lead to investigation.

items.task: Add a real SMS Gateway/provider operations page.
items.closure: Bind identity/ownership/build/SIM or provider status, internet/telephony/permissions, local/server backlog, journal, heartbeat and lifecycle to real services. Enrollment/revoke/allowlisted test actions require backend authority. No fake online or delivery badge.

items.task: Complete Automations status, runs, policy and access.
items.closure: Add effective modes/caps, actual runner/cadence ownership, unacknowledged work, last attempt versus success, execution location, actions/exceptions and audit links. Keep Run now/schedule editing absent until backed by the selected integration.

items.task: Complete joined audit and governed domain settings.
items.closure: Link payment/posting/receipt/attempt/run/real actor; implement approved balance/disclosure/template/language/recipient/sender-limit/device/retention settings with permission, version, reason and audit checks. Reuse existing governed toggles.

items.task: Finish shared UX and selected-skill acceptance.
items.closure: Fix remaining icon-only specialized headings and incomplete offline/stale/partial states; verify configured navigation and all declared routes/actions/roles/session transitions, keyboard/screen-reader, light/dark/narrow/doubled text and live-update stability. Obtain applicable Business/operator comparators and owner acceptance.

items.task: Approve financial and receipt semantics.
items.closure: Approve provider/statement evidence or an explicit constrained assurance policy, reference scope, payer-versus-member/group allocation, savings/balance definitions, late intent, fees/corrections/reversals, verified recipients, consent/group disclosure, languages and segment costs. Preserve existing atomic posting/journals/snapshots and current fixed-template uniqueness.

items.task: Implement safe pause/resume and missed-receipt reconciliation.
items.closure: The disabled SMS flag currently skips outbox creation. Define dispatch pause versus deliberate suppression, preserve eligible durable work and implement controlled catch-up/backfill without contacting opted-out/app-linked members or blindly sending historical receipts.

items.task: Create a dedicated unattended operational identity.
items.closure: Separate device/human/supervisor credentials, define server-derived allowed scope, constrain every entity reference and revocation/renewal path, and deny financial authority, unrestricted SMS/SQL/shell/OTP access. Current manual platform-owner authority remains separate.

items.task: Add committed business events and durable consumer acknowledgements.
items.closure: Emit posting/late-allocation/reversal/actionable-failure events; use commit-safe progress or per-event ACK, bounded batches, partial recovery and periodic reconciliation. Creation-time pending pagination is not a durable acknowledgement contract.

items.task: Add constrained ensure/enqueue-receipt services and MCP tools.
items.closure: Accept only transaction ID, expected version and operational run reference; derive recipient/text/balances/policy server-side. Revalidate scope, posting, contact, consent, version, lease/fence, pause/caps and lifetime uniqueness; return stable business reason codes and existing receipt identity.

items.task: Add safe retry, cancellation, correction and intentional-resend operations.
items.closure: Retry only definitely-unsent policy-eligible attempts with version/fence checks; investigate uncertainty without transport switching or blind replay. Restrict cancellation to safely unstarted work. Keep corrections/resends linked, reasoned and approved; template changes must not recreate primary receipts.

items.task: Add durable operational exception services.
items.closure: Deduplicate bounded reason-coded exceptions by entity/event, track assignment/escalation/resolution and audit lineage, and expose minimal-data MCP actions without accepting raw untrusted SMS as instructions.

items.task: Add an action-supervisor lease and validated completion contract.
items.closure: Bind approved scope, principal, batch and every permitted side effect to an expiring fenced run; acknowledge only durable handled events and derive action/exception counters on the server. Manual health sampling is not event-processing completion.

items.task: Enforce operating modes, limits and emergency stop.
items.closure: Store/enforce Shadow, Dry-run, Live-limited, Live and Paused policies with per-run/group/device/global action/SMS caps and audited human resume. Pause blocks new dispatch authority while ingestion continues; it cannot recall carrier handoff.

items.task: Choose and implement one approved automatic sender.
items.closure: Implement organization-owned Android gateway OR authorized SMS-provider adapter. Bind short-lived authorization to receipt/attempt/payload/scope/device/fence; persist pre-send journal and callbacks, authenticate/idempotently process per-part results and preserve uncertainty. Current Android inbound receiver and assisted Apple Messages workflow are not unattended senders.

items.task: Implement sender enrollment, revocation and independent health.
items.closure: Expose actual credentials/build/ownership, selected SIM/subscription where applicable, permission/telephony/internet, local journal/backlog and heartbeat; prove revoked devices cannot send and lost callbacks reconcile with the original journal/provider.

items.task: Configure a real scheduler and recovery runner.
items.closure: Choose a Collect-owned deterministic checker or supported always-on Codex runner; prove host availability, cadence/runtime/quota, overlap, bounded batches, stale runs, disconnections and recovery. Remote HTTP/OAuth is conditional on the chosen hosting. Existing push scheduling is separate from SMS/Codex scheduling.

items.task: Measure real latency, capacity, health and cost.
items.closure: Finish pipeline/gateway/supervisor metric coverage, actionable alerts and operator drills; measure ingestion→posting→queue→sent, queue age, delivery coverage, unknowns, duplicate suppression, allocation/reconciliation differences, p95/p99/backlog drain and measured SMS/OTP/AI budgets. Existing database metrics need final integration and representative volume.

items.task: Execute the complete payment/receipt failure matrix.
items.closure: Use representative authorized financial evidence and real allowlisted devices/providers: duplicates, concurrent posting, late allocation, multipart uncertainty, crash after send/lost ACK, journal restart, permission/network/power loss, queue repetition, pause, reversals, cross-scope access, prompt injection and restore. Prove normal payment/receipt processing when Codex is offline.

items.task: Close privacy, financial, carrier/provider and distribution prerequisites.
items.closure: Obtain accountable regulatory/privacy/vendor/hosting/inference/retention decisions and disclosures for actual flows, verified contacts/group totals and lawful processing. Confirm selected sender commercial terms, consent, rate/segment costs and applicable distribution/permission approval through actual owners.

items.task: Complete source trust, supply-chain, signing and store/device acceptance.
items.closure: Refresh sharing/exposure and redacted secret scans; rotate evidenced exposed credentials. Regenerate locks/inventory/SBOM/provenance and license/asset reviews from frozen source; build/sign/install exact Android/iOS bytes, run real USSD/SMS/Integrity/push/privacy/key-loss journeys and refresh store-console evidence. Do not restore retired assets or diaspora/Stripe requirements.

items.task: Prove actual disaster recovery and upgrade recovery.
items.closure: Approve RPO/RTO; restore database, Auth, roles/grants/configuration, receipt/ledger evidence, independent Storage objects, sender journals/keys and external evidence in isolation. Reconcile balances and pending work, measure recovery time and verify off-site recovery and version compatibility.

items.task: Complete accountable operations and incident runbooks.
items.closure: Assign on-call/support/finance/security/release owners; rehearse sender/provider/OTP/Codex outages, stuck or corrupt queues, compromise, wrong allocation, uncertain sends, emergency pause and rollback. Retain operator handover, contacts, audit retention and evidence export procedures.

items.task: Complete an allowlisted capped pilot and release decision.
items.closure: Progress shadow→allowlisted sends→capped group pilot with daily independent reconciliation, support/monitoring, stop/rollback criteria and documented outcomes. Bind deployment/signed hashes/locks/tests/exclusions/policy decisions to one handover and obtain accountable GO before expansion.

owner_design_scope_amendment.scope: Sole revolut-design authority; separately named mobile checklist and its mandatory gates removed at owner request. Previous integrity claims for changed bytes are withdrawn. Existing technical observations retain their dated scope.
